title: The pineapple target during a remote viewing session with McMoneagle

tellings.quote: Yeah. No, I've been with Mc Monagle and experienced it myself where it's like a friend of mine drew like a little spiky thing and it was a pineapple

plain: During a remote viewing session, the practice of trying to sense a hidden target with the mind, a friend of Michels drew a little spiky thing, and the target turned out to be a pineapple. Michels tells this himself, saying he was there with the remote viewer Joe McMoneagle and experienced it first-hand.
